welcome.title: Welcome to Flixer
welcome.description: Let's get your server ready. This only takes a minute.

quick.title: Quick Setup
quick.description: Connect the database, create your administrator account and finish. Everything else uses sensible defaults.

advanced.title: Advanced Setup
advanced.description: Control every service, secret and address yourself.

database.title: Connect your database
database.description: Flixer stores your library and accounts in PostgreSQL.
database.notReady: The database was saved but Flixer is still starting. Wait a moment and try Continue again.

admin.title: Create the administrator
admin.description: This account manages Flixer. The first account is always the administrator.
admin.verification: This account needs email verification before it can be used. Verify it, then continue.

urls.title: Where will you open Flixer?
urls.description: The address people use in their browser. It is also used for passkeys.
urls.hint: Use the address you type in the browser. Passkeys need https unless it is localhost.
urls.appUrlHint: Leave empty to use the address above.
urls.passkeyRpIdHint: Leave empty to derive it from the address.
urls.passkeyOriginsHint: Comma-separated https origins. Leave empty to use the web app address.

redis.title: Connect Redis
redis.description: Redis queues background work such as media scans.

recovery.description: Setup was completed, but this server has no database configured. Enter the recovery code printed in the Flixer server log to reconnect one. Your accounts and library live in the database, so use the one you had before.

key.title: Enter the recovery key
key.description: A recovery key was just written to the Flixer server log. Enter it to continue setup without signing in.
key.hint: Look for "recovery key" in the API log, for example: docker compose logs api

recovered.title: Database reconnected
recovered.description: Flixer is running again. Continue to sign in with your existing account.
